Privacy & Cookies

Cookies & Analytics

This site uses Google Analytics (GA4) to understand how visitors use the interactive notebooks — page views, referrers, and an approximate location (country/region) derived from IP address. Analytics cookies are only set after you accept them in the cookie banner; if you decline, you can keep browsing normally and no analytics cookies are set.

Google acts as a data processor for this aggregated traffic data. See Google's Privacy Policy for details on how Google handles it.

No accounts, forms, or other personal data are collected on this site.

Contact
